# `quadratic-front-removal`

<!-- rule-docs:header (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
Tier: style · Profile: disciplined · Default: off · Fixes: none · Options: none

Reports `orderedRemove(0)` while a loop drains the same `ArrayList` according to
its remaining length.
<!-- /rule-docs:header -->

## Why it matters

Every ordered front removal shifts all remaining elements. Draining the complete
list this way performs quadratic work.

## When it fires

This disciplined-profile rule requires a visible `ArrayList`, a loop condition
over that list's `items.len`, and a literal zero removal index. One-off front
removal and non-front removal remain unreported.

<!-- rule-docs:footer (generated by `zig build rule-docs`) -->
## Example

```zig
const std = @import("std");

fn drain(queue: *std.ArrayList(u32)) void {
    while (queue.items.len > 0) {
        _ = queue.orderedRemove(0);
    }
}
```
